name: Crow Wing River (Huntersville–Cottingham)
gaugeName: Crow Wing River at Nimrod, MN

gaugeContext.note: The Nimrod station provides same-river flow context. These trips span upstream and downstream reaches and tributaries; this reading does not establish flow at every landing or a calibrated paddling speed.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS Water Data — Crow Wing River at Nimrod, station 05244000

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model or matching numeric agency trip times. Reference flow, public access maps and published planning mileage remain available.

blurb: Choose forest paddles near Huntersville, rapids above Nimrod, or shorter outings between Little White Dog, Knob Hill and Cottingham. Public carry-in locations are labelled as approximate areas, with current agency trip mileage and access directions.

sections.notes: The DNR-recommended Huntersville North–Mary Brown day trip through Huntersville State Forest. Both ends are carry-ins. Arrange your shuttle and keep the separate Huntersville South and campground accesses distinct.

sections.difficulty: Class I rapids; Class II possible at high water
sections.notes: Continue through Burrows and Westra Rapids to the Nimrod carry-in. DNR rates Burrows Class I and Westra Class I–II depending on water level. The landing is across the river from Stigman’s Mound picnic park; do not aim for the picnic area.
